high_level_description: The image shows two individuals posing closely together for a selfie. The person on the left has dark hair styled in loose waves and is wearing a black top. They have their eyes closed and appear to be making a playful facial expression with their lips puckered as if they are about to kiss or are playfully biting their lip. The person on the right also has dark hair styled similarly but is wearing a sleeveless beige top. They are leaning in close to the other person, with one hand resting on their shoulder, and are making a similar playful facial expression with their lips puckered.
